description: Save the artifact of an existing completed export_job_id to local disk, including after reconnecting. Preserves original bytes, including ZIP; does not parse JSON, unpack ZIP, wait for completion, or submit another export. Use get_export_job or wait_for_export_job first if needed. Verifies artifact size and SHA-256 before atomic publication. Returns output_path. overwrite defaults false; enable only when replacing a local file is intended. An expired artifact cannot be recovered by retrying this download.

output_path.description: Optional local file path or existing directory on the server's machine. Prefer an absolute path; ~ is not expanded. Omit to save in the server's working directory using the artifact filename. Original bytes may be ZIP regardless of the requested export format.

overwrite.description: Allow replacing an existing local file. Defaults to false.

name: download_export_job
title: Download Export Job
